prerequisite_rule: Needs Power Grid or Power Grid: Recharged.
what_it_adds: A double-sided board with a Benelux map and a Central Europe map, each with small rule changes.
what_it_fixes: Gives a faster, cheaper-to-build map with plentiful resources, so a repeat group can vary the game without a steeper rules load.
verdict_reason: Benelux is described as the map to teach new players and plays about 30% faster, and a BGG regular calls this pair the best bang-for-your-buck map expansion.
notes: Amazon title is generic (not labelled Recharged); Rio Grande's Recharged edition is the same maps with updated rules.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Power Grid or Power Grid: Recharged.
what_it_adds: 30 robot tiles that build computer-controlled players from random behaviour traits for auctions, resources and city building.
what_it_fixes: Fills the empty seats in a 2-3 player game so Power Grid keeps its auction tension without needing five humans.
verdict_reason: At under $15 a longtime player calls it an unequivocal yes for 2-3 player tables, though another reviewer says the robots can hand the first player a clear advantage.
notes: Fan reviewer notes the rules are loosely written and need some interpretation.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Power Grid or Power Grid: Recharged.
what_it_adds: Korea and China maps: Korea splits buying into two resource markets (North/South), and China brings planned-economy rules where plants come out in ascending order.
what_it_fixes: Gives experienced groups a tougher, more constrained game once the base maps feel solved.
verdict_reason: A BGG regular rates Korea the most fun map for very experienced groups and names it among his favourites, but warns China is a brutally scarce map unsuited to beginners.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Power Grid or Power Grid: Recharged.
what_it_adds: Map pair: France starts nuclear earlier with more uranium, while Italy has expensive coal and oil and more garbage.
what_it_fixes: Adds a map that plays close to the base rules but changes which plants matter, including the usually weak 11 and 17.
verdict_reason: A BGG regular puts France/Italy in the less-advanced group of maps that stays close to base play, with the France map also a favourite of the thread author.
notes: Recharged edition ASIN; an older listing B095J644DY also exists but did not return a title.

expansion_name: Northern Europe / United Kingdom & Ireland Recharged
prerequisite_rule: Needs Power Grid or Power Grid: Recharged.
what_it_adds: Northern Europe and UK/Ireland maps, plus 12 extra power plant cards for the Northern Europe side that work with any map.
what_it_fixes: Adds regionally varied plant mixes and the quirk of two separate UK/Irish networks.
verdict_reason: BGG regulars call Northern Europe a lot of fun thanks to its extra plant cards, though they note the UK/Ireland map is quirky with uneven region sizes.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Power Grid or Power Grid: Recharged.
what_it_adds: Quebec (hub-and-spoke map, lower resource restock) and Baden-Württemberg (turn order set after the auctions).
what_it_fixes: Adds a tight, bidding-heavy 5-6 player map and a subtle turn-order change.
verdict_reason: Two BGG regulars say they like both maps, with Quebec favoured for 5-6 player games, though Baden-Württemberg's rule shifts are easy to forget.
notes: Rio Grande lists this one without the Recharged label; the maps are unchanged.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Power Grid or Power Grid: Recharged.
what_it_adds: Brazil (biogas replaces garbage, scarce resources) and Spain/Portugal (wind plants and nuclear step-2 rules); comes in a storage box.
what_it_fixes: Gives a resource-scarcity map for groups that want longer, nastier games; the box holds the other map expansions.
verdict_reason: A BGG reviewer calls Brazil a brutal resource shortage that can drag a 3-player game to 2 hours and says the Spain/Portugal wind rule feels off, though it is the only map set with a storage box.
notes: Pricier than other maps because of the box.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Power Grid or Power Grid: Recharged.
what_it_adds: Russia (restricted plant market, scrapping rule) and Japan (two separate starting networks, claustrophobic long map).
what_it_fixes: Adds advanced rules changes for groups that already know the base map set.
verdict_reason: A BGG regular groups Russia/Japan with China/Korea as advanced maps that really change the game, and another reviewer calls Japan claustrophobic with brutal resource shortages.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Power Grid or Power Grid: Recharged.
what_it_adds: Middle East map (cheap oil/natural gas early, no uranium or garbage at first) and a South Africa map (abundant coal, international connections).
what_it_fixes: Gives a map pair with a shifting fuel mix that forces a mid-game change of plant strategy.
verdict_reason: A BGG regular who owns most of the maps says he did not much care for these, noting the Middle East's odd shape makes the positional game dominate.
notes: Rio Grande page lists it as out of stock when archived.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Power Grid or Power Grid: Recharged.
what_it_adds: Two large 7-region maps (Europe and North America) first released in the 2014 Deluxe edition, redrawn for Recharged.
what_it_fixes: Lets a table build across whole continents on a bigger board.
verdict_reason: Only a description and community stats back this one (BGG weight 3.0, plays best 4-5), so it suits groups that already own Recharged and want a larger map rather than a first expansion.
notes: Rio Grande listed this as out of print when archived; check stock. No independent critical review read.

expansion_name: The New Power Plant Cards Set 1
prerequisite_rule: Needs Power Grid or Power Grid: Recharged.
what_it_adds: A replacement power-plant deck with green-bordered cards, more evenly spaced efficiency, and a variant for longer games.
what_it_fixes: Smooths the plant market for new groups at the cost of less auction tension.
verdict_reason: A BGG reviewer says it is a kinder, gentler deck best for new players and that experienced groups will find the auctions less dynamic, so buy it mainly for teaching.
notes: Original Plant Deck 2 appeared in 2007; Rio Grande's Recharged-branded Set 1 reprints that deck.
